theme.en: AI Demand Pulls the Supply Chain Tighter

dek.en: The day's highest-signal stories point to the same constraint: AI compute is no longer just about accelerator launches, but about capacity, memory, packaging, financing, and export enforcement. TSMC's Arizona approval, Nvidia's financing model, and SK hynix's long-range memory spend all show how the AI cycle is moving upstream into fabs and materials.
dek.zh: 今天的主线很清晰：AI算力竞争不再只是新加速器发布，而是被产能、存储、封装、融资和出口管制共同约束。TSMC亚利桑那扩建获批、Nvidia新的融资模式，以及SK hynix的长期存储投资，都说明AI周期正在向晶圆厂和材料端传导。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia offers cloud customers a revenue-share financing model
title.zh: Nvidia向AI云客户推出收入分成式融资模式

summary.en: Nvidia is offering an optional structure that lets it take a cut of AI cloud revenue on top of hardware sales. The model turns GPU deployment into a recurring economics question rather than a one-time server purchase. It may help customers finance large clusters, but it also ties cloud margins and accelerator supply more closely to Nvidia's platform control.
summary.zh: Nvidia正在提供一种可选结构：除硬件销售收入外，还从AI云服务收入中分成。这把GPU部署从一次性服务器采购，变成了持续收益分配问题。它可能帮助客户为大型集群融资，但也会让云服务利润率和加速器供给更深地绑定在Nvidia平台上。

title.en: Anthropic is reportedly in talks with Samsung for a custom AI chip
title.zh: 报道称Anthropic正与Samsung洽谈自研AI芯片

summary.en: Anthropic is reportedly the latest AI lab looking at its own accelerator, with Samsung named as a potential partner. The report fits a broader pattern of model companies trying to lower inference cost and reduce dependence on merchant GPUs. For Samsung, such a deal would matter because custom AI silicon can pull through foundry, memory, and advanced packaging demand together.
summary.zh: 报道称Anthropic成为最新一家考虑自研加速器的AI实验室，Samsung被列为潜在合作方。这符合模型公司降低推理成本、减少对通用GPU依赖的趋势。对Samsung而言，这类订单的意义在于自研AI芯片可能同时带动foundry、存储和先进封装需求。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC wins approval for a US$20 billion Arizona expansion
title.zh: TSMC获批在亚利桑那扩建200亿美元项目

summary.en: TSMC won approval for a US$20 billion expansion in Arizona, adding another formal step to its U.S. manufacturing buildout. The approval matters because advanced-node capacity outside Taiwan remains a strategic priority for customers and policymakers. Execution risk remains in costs, staffing, tool availability, and how quickly the site can match Taiwan's manufacturing density.
summary.zh: TSMC在亚利桑那的200亿美元扩建项目获得批准，为其美国制造布局再推进一步。这一批准重要，是因为台湾以外的先进制程产能仍是客户和政策制定者的战略重点。后续执行风险仍在成本、人员、设备供给，以及该基地能多快接近台湾厂区的制造密度。

title.en: Intel and TSMC push into glass substrates as panel packaging scales
title.zh: Intel和TSMC加码玻璃基板，面板级封装进入扩张期

summary.en: Intel and TSMC are being linked to glass substrates and panel-level packaging as the market heads toward reported 10x growth. The interest reflects a packaging bottleneck: AI accelerators need larger packages, denser routing, and better dimensional stability than organic substrates can always provide. The technology is still early, but foundry participation signals that substrates are becoming part of advanced-node competitiveness.
summary.zh: 报道称Intel和TSMC正在布局玻璃基板与面板级封装，相关市场预计走向10倍增长。背后的约束来自封装端：AI加速器需要更大的封装尺寸、更高密度布线，以及比有机基板更好的尺寸稳定性。该技术仍处早期，但晶圆代工厂参与说明基板已经成为先进节点竞争力的一部分。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix outlines a US$712.5 billion South Korea investment plan
title.zh: SK hynix提出7125亿美元韩国本土投资计划

summary.en: SK hynix announced a reported US$712.5 billion plan for South Korean operations, with Cheongju NAND expansion and the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster for DRAM called out. The detailed pieces include a new NAND fab and a packaging facility, tying memory capacity to advanced packaging needs. The scale underscores how HBM, DRAM, and NAND roadmaps are being planned around sustained AI infrastructure demand.
summary.zh: SK hynix宣布了据称规模达7125亿美元的韩国本土运营投资计划，其中包括Cheongju NAND扩建和Yongin Semiconductor Cluster的DRAM布局。已披露的具体项目包括新的NAND fab和封装设施，把存储产能与先进封装需求联系在一起。这一规模显示，HBM、DRAM和NAND路线图正围绕持续的AI基础设施需求重新规划。

title.en: Kioxia readies next-generation memory for mass production
title.zh: Kioxia准备下一代存储进入量产

summary.en: Kioxia is preparing next-generation memory for mass production as AI demand improves the company's outlook. The story is less about HBM directly and more about the storage side of the AI stack, where training data, checkpoints, and inference services keep lifting NAND requirements. A stronger Kioxia also changes competitive pressure in a NAND market that has been recovering from a deep down-cycle.
summary.zh: Kioxia正准备让下一代存储进入量产，AI需求正在改善公司的复苏前景。这条新闻并非直接指向HBM，而是指向AI堆栈中的存储层，训练数据、模型检查点和推理服务都会继续拉动NAND需求。Kioxia走强也会改变NAND市场在深度下行周期后复苏阶段的竞争压力。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Air Liquide commits over US$170 million to SK hynix's Indiana fab supply chain
title.zh: Air Liquide为SK hynix印第安纳工厂供应链投资超1.7亿美元

summary.en: Air Liquide will invest more than US$170 million to supply ultra-pure gases for SK hynix's first U.S. chip facility in Indiana. Materials infrastructure is often the hidden schedule item in new fabs, because gas purity and continuity affect both yield and ramp reliability. The investment shows how memory packaging and fab projects are creating second-order demand for specialty gas suppliers.
summary.zh: Air Liquide将投资超过1.7亿美元，为SK hynix在印第安纳的首个美国芯片工厂供应超高纯气体。材料基础设施通常是新厂进度中不显眼但关键的一环，因为气体纯度和连续供应会直接影响良率与爬坡稳定性。这笔投资说明，存储封装和晶圆厂项目正在为特种气体供应商创造二阶需求。

title.en: ASML demand mix shifts as memory makers take a larger role
title.zh: 存储厂商权重上升，ASML需求结构出现变化

summary.en: ASML's demand picture is being framed around a shift toward memory makers as the market wobbles. That matters because lithography demand is no longer only a leading-edge logic story; DRAM, HBM-adjacent process steps, and NAND recovery can all affect tool ordering. The mix will be important for investors watching whether memory strength can offset choppier logic spending.
summary.zh: 围绕ASML的最新报道强调，市场波动中存储厂商在需求结构中的权重上升。这很重要，因为光刻需求不再只是先进逻辑制程的故事；DRAM、HBM相关工艺步骤，以及NAND复苏都可能影响设备订单。对投资者而言，关键在于存储端强度能否抵消逻辑客户支出的波动。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia uses Huawei as its argument against tighter chip export limits
title.zh: Nvidia以Huawei竞争为由游说放宽芯片出口限制

summary.en: Nvidia is using the prospect of Huawei gains to strengthen its case in the U.S. chip export debate. The argument is that stricter controls could push Chinese customers toward domestic accelerators rather than preserving U.S. leadership. The policy question is whether near-term Nvidia access to China helps maintain standards influence or instead expands the installed base of restricted AI compute.
summary.zh: Nvidia正在美国芯片出口管制讨论中，以Huawei可能受益作为自身论点。其逻辑是，更严格的限制可能把中国客户推向本土加速器，而不是维护美国领先地位。政策层面的关键问题是，短期允许Nvidia继续进入中国市场，是有助于维持技术标准影响力，还是会扩大受限AI算力的装机基础。

title.en: Super Micro faces fresh export-control scrutiny in Taiwan
title.zh: Super Micro在台湾面临新的出口管制审查

summary.en: Super Micro is facing export-control scrutiny in Taiwan, adding compliance risk to the AI server supply chain. The issue matters because server vendors sit at the junction between restricted GPUs, ODM manufacturing, and end-customer deployment. Even when chip vendors are the policy focus, enforcement can move downstream to systems, logistics, and channel controls.
summary.zh: Super Micro在台湾面临出口管制审查，使AI服务器供应链增加合规风险。这一事件重要，是因为服务器厂商处在受限GPU、ODM制造和终端客户部署之间的交汇点。即使政策焦点常在芯片厂商身上，执法也可能下沉到整机系统、物流和渠道控制。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: Etched steps out of stealth with a reported US$5 billion valuation
title.zh: Etched走出隐身期，估值据称达到50亿美元

summary.en: Etched, an Nvidia challenger focused on AI inference silicon, has stepped out of stealth with a reported US$5 billion valuation. The valuation reflects investor demand for alternatives to general-purpose GPUs as inference workloads scale. The next test is not just chip performance, but whether Etched can secure supply, software support, and real customer deployments fast enough.
summary.zh: 面向AI推理芯片的Nvidia挑战者Etched走出隐身期，估值据称达到50亿美元。这一估值反映出随着推理工作负载扩张，投资者对通用GPU替代方案的需求。接下来的考验不只是芯片性能，而是Etched能否足够快地拿到产能、建立软件支持，并获得真实客户部署。

stories.source: MIT Sloan Management Review Middle East

theme.en: Inference Bottlenecks Move Into Memory and Packaging
theme.zh: 推理瓶颈转向存储与封装

dek.en: This week's papers cluster around the same systems problem: long-context AI and edge inference are limited by data movement as much as arithmetic. The stronger contributions use chiplet links, compute-in-memory, KV-cache compression, NoC design, and EDA scaling to attack that bottleneck from different layers.
dek.zh: 本周论文集中指向同一个系统问题：长上下文AI和边缘推理的限制不仅来自算术单元，也来自数据搬移。较强的工作分别从chiplet互连、存算一体、KV-cache压缩、NoC设计和EDA扩展性等层面处理这一瓶颈。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: 3DLS: A 3D Logic-Stacked Architecture for Disaggregated LLM Serving
title.zh: 3DLS：面向解耦LLM服务的3D逻辑堆叠架构

papers.authors: J. Lee, I.-J. Jung, J.-Y. Kim

summary.en: 3DLS proposes a logic-on-logic 3D-stacked chiplet architecture for LLM serving that separates prefill-to-decode KV-cache transfers from decode-side tensor-parallel collectives. By routing KV traffic through vertical interconnects and keeping collectives on lateral die-to-die links, it reduces mixed-traffic contention. The reported gains reach up to 1.49x throughput and 60.2% lower end-to-end latency versus a shared-fabric planar baseline.
summary.zh: 3DLS提出一种面向LLM服务的逻辑-逻辑3D堆叠chiplet架构，把prefill到decode的KV-cache传输与decode侧tensor parallel通信分离。它通过垂直互连承载KV流量，同时把collective通信保留在横向die-to-die链路上，从而降低混合流量竞争。论文报告相对共享平面互连基线最高可实现1.49倍吞吐，并降低60.2%的端到端延迟。

title.en: MxGLUT: A LUT-Centric Accelerator for Mixed-Precision GEMM
title.zh: MxGLUT：面向混合精度GEMM的LUT中心化加速器

papers.authors: W. Zhou, C. Ding, M. Liu, et al.

summary.en: MxGLUT targets LLM inference where FP8 activations meet low-bit compressed weights and conventional accelerators need separate datapaths. The design uses mixed-precision LUT-based processing elements and a reconfigurable broadcast dataflow to support FP8-INT4 and FP8-FP8 GEMMs under one execution mechanism. Synthesized in 28 nm CMOS at 200 MHz, it is a useful architecture study for reducing multiplier-heavy area in inference accelerators.
summary.zh: MxGLUT面向LLM推理中FP8 activation与低比特压缩权重混合计算的场景，解决传统加速器需要独立数据通路的问题。该设计使用混合精度LUT处理单元和可重构broadcast dataflow，在同一执行机制下支持FP8-INT4与FP8-FP8 GEMM。其在28 nm CMOS、200 MHz下综合验证，是减少推理加速器中乘法器面积开销的有价值架构研究。

title.en: D6CIM: 60.4-TOPS/W All-Digital 6T-SRAM Compute-in-Memory Macro
title.zh: D6CIM：60.4 TOPS/W全数字6T-SRAM存算一体宏

papers.authors: J. Oh, C.-T. Lin, M. Seok

summary.en: D6CIM demonstrates an all-digital 6T-SRAM compute-in-memory macro supporting 1-to-8-bit fixed-point vector-matrix multiplication. The 28 nm CMOS prototype reaches about 360 MHz at 1.1 V, up to 60.4 TOPS/W, 1.46 TOPS/mm2 compute density, and 1005 kb/mm2 weight density. The key contribution is balancing energy efficiency, compute density, and weight density without relying on analog sensing margins.
summary.zh: D6CIM展示了一种全数字6T-SRAM存算一体宏，支持1到8 bit定点向量-矩阵乘法。其28 nm CMOS原型在1.1 V下约360 MHz运行，最高达到60.4 TOPS/W、1.46 TOPS/mm2计算密度和1005 kb/mm2权重密度。关键贡献在于不依赖模拟感测裕量，同时平衡能效、计算密度和权重密度。

title.en: A 28-nm FD-SOI PCM Analog-IMC Core With 4M Cells
title.zh: 基于4M单元PCM的28 nm FD-SOI模拟存算核心

papers.authors: M. Pasotti, R. Zurla, J. J. B. Agnoletto, et al.

summary.en: This JSSC paper presents a phase-change-memory analog IMC macro fabricated in 28 nm FD-SOI CMOS with a 4M-cell array and eight 512-by-512-weight layers. The design emphasizes multilayer computation that is resilient to drift and temperature, reporting matrix-vector multiplication error below 2.14% from -40 C to +125 C. It is notable because dense non-volatile storage is directly tied to usable DNN compute, not just a standalone memory metric.
summary.zh: 这篇JSSC论文展示了一个基于phase-change memory的模拟IMC宏，采用28 nm FD-SOI CMOS制造，集成4M cell阵列和8个512乘512权重层。设计重点是具备漂移和温度鲁棒性的多层计算，在-40 C到+125 C范围内报告矩阵-向量乘法误差低于2.14%。其意义在于把高密度非易失存储直接转化为可用的DNN计算能力，而不只是展示单独的存储指标。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: Physically-Aware Preemptive Virtual Channels for AXI NoCs
title.zh: 面向AXI NoC的物理感知抢占式虚通道

papers.authors: L. Leone, L. Colagrande, L. Benini

summary.en: This paper revisits deadlock-free AXI network-on-chip design, where read and write dependencies can create circular waits even when routing is nominally safe. The proposed preemptive virtual channels target wide-link NoCs and avoid the routing pressure of full multiplane duplication. Reported results show up to 76% link-resource savings with comparable frequency and only 3% router-area overhead versus a multiplane baseline.
summary.zh: 这篇论文重新审视AXI network-on-chip的无死锁设计问题，其中读写依赖即使在路由算法本身安全时也可能形成环形等待。作者提出的抢占式虚通道面向宽链路NoC，避免完全多平面复制带来的布线压力。结果显示，相比多平面基线，可节省最高76%的链路资源，同时频率相近、router面积开销仅约3%。

title.en: LLM Inference & AI Systems
title.zh: LLM推理与AI系统

title.en: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for Long-Context KV Cache
title.zh: RaBitQCache：用于长上下文KV Cache的旋转二值量化

papers.authors: W. Li, J. Dong, H. Zhang, et al.

summary.en: RaBitQCache attacks the long-context KV-cache bottleneck with randomized rotated binary quantization and binary-INT4 arithmetic for estimating attention weights. Instead of a fixed Top-k budget, it uses an adaptive Top-p retrieval rule backed by an error-bounded proxy score. The system additions, including asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates, are important because KV compression only helps if its own overhead is hidden during decoding.
summary.zh: RaBitQCache用随机旋转二值量化和binary-INT4算术估计attention权重，以处理长上下文KV-cache瓶颈。它不使用固定Top-k预算，而是基于带误差界的代理分数执行自适应Top-p检索。系统层面的异步流水和lazy update同样关键，因为KV压缩只有在自身开销能被decode过程隐藏时才真正有效。

title.en: SeKV: Resolution-Adaptive KV Cache With Hierarchical Semantic Memory
title.zh: SeKV：具有分层语义记忆的分辨率自适应KV Cache

papers.authors: A. Abaskohi, G. Carenini, P. West, Y. He

summary.en: SeKV keeps long-context information in a GPU-CPU hierarchy instead of simply evicting tokens from the KV cache. It groups context into entropy-guided semantic spans, stores lightweight summaries on GPU, and keeps low-rank SVD bases on CPU for query-triggered reconstruction. The approach is compelling because it preserves a path back to token-level detail when a compressed span becomes relevant later in generation.
summary.zh: SeKV不是简单从KV cache中驱逐token，而是把长上下文信息保存在GPU-CPU分层结构中。它将上下文组织为熵引导的语义span，在GPU上保留轻量摘要，并在CPU上保存低秩SVD基，用于查询触发的重构。该方法有吸引力，因为当压缩span在生成后续阶段重新变得相关时，系统仍能恢复到token级细节。

title.en: Quantum & Ising Hardware
title.zh: 量子与Ising硬件

title.en: A 2048-Spin Bulk Acoustic Wave Ising Machine
title.zh: 2048自旋体声波Ising机

papers.authors: V. Vadde, R. Ovcharov, V. H. Gonzalez, et al.

summary.en: The paper demonstrates a time-multiplexed Ising machine built from propagating wave packets in microwave-frequency bulk acoustic wave delay lines. Two 20.5 MHz, 707 us delay lines support 2,048 spins with all-to-all connectivity and 15-bit coupling resolution. The system finds approximate Max-Cut solutions in 341 ms and reports four orders of magnitude higher thermal stability than coherent optical Ising-machine approaches.
summary.zh: 这篇论文展示了一种时间复用Ising机，利用微波频段体声波延迟线中的传播波包实现。两个20.5 MHz、707 us延迟线支持2048个自旋，具备全连接和15 bit耦合分辨率。系统可在341 ms内找到近似Max-Cut解，并报告相比相干光Ising机高四个数量级的热稳定性。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: HySpecPro: Scalable Hypergraph Partitioning via Spectral Projection
title.zh: HySpecPro：基于谱投影的可扩展超图划分

papers.authors: R. Liang, Z. Feng, H. Ren

summary.en: HySpecPro proposes a single-level hypergraph partitioner for very large VLSI designs, avoiding distortions introduced during multilevel coarsening. It builds spectral embeddings from a bipartite Laplacian and performs projection-based search with a fully GPU-accelerated implementation. The main result is practical scaling: cut quality comparable to strong multilevel methods while scaling linearly with total hyperedge degree.
summary.zh: HySpecPro提出一种面向超大规模VLSI设计的单层超图划分器，避免多层coarsening过程中引入的结构失真。它从二部Laplacian构建谱嵌入，并通过GPU加速的投影搜索完成优化。主要结果在于实用扩展性：切割质量可与强多层方法相比，同时相对总超边度呈线性扩展。
